details: Audited first-player flow across initial load, menu, showroom, world select, gameplay start, powerups, hazard alerts, crash, and mobile portrait viewports via test/audit-phase9-player-experience.mjs with high-res captures in artifacts/phase9/

Diagnosed key defects: GameOverModal top header clipping due to unconstrained flexbox auto-scrolling on retryBtn focus, mobile lobby 3-tier grid overlapping runner head, visual hazard cues placed directly in central train sightlines, missing UI click audio triggers, and lingering train rumble on game over

Applied surgical fixes: added preventScroll: true and scrollTop = 0 to GameOverModal; restructured mobile lobby header to 2-tier compact layout; moved .hud-hazard-cue outside track sightline to top margin; connected delegated click listener on #ui-overlay to emit EVENTS.UI_CLICK; silenced trainRumbleGain and reset footstep timer on EVENTS.GAME_OVER; authored comprehensive sound production brief in docs/audio-production-brief.md and heuristic UX audit in docs/phase9-player-experience-ux-audit.md

Re-captured screenshots verifying zero modal clipping, clean mobile viewport, clear central track sightline, and crisp tactile audio. Executed full validation: npm run build (pass), 58 audio soundscape tests (pass), UI progression tests (pass), 57 worldgen tests (pass), 86 train-gap tests (pass), 248 rooftop regression assertions (pass), 75 real browser rooftop collision scenarios (pass), 6 real browser train gap validations (pass), 12 character/camera polish suites (pass)
All release criteria verified. Clean git working tree ready for commit directly to main and push to origin/main
